newsitem.title: BELGIUM: ActivCard reports half year, Q2 losses.
newsitem.headline: ActivCard reports half year, Q2 losses.

text.p: ActivCard SA, a maker of personal authentication cards, had a net loss of $5.4 million in the six months to June 30 from $5.3 million a year earlier, the company said on Wednesday.
It said revenues for the six months were up more than seven percent at $3.7 million compared with $3.5 million a year ago.
Losses per share were 35 cents for the first six months of 1997 compared with 46 cents in the six months to June 30, 1996.
In the second quarter of this year, the company lost $2.4 million on revenues of $2.3 million compared with a loss of $2.7 million on revenues of $2.2 million in the 1996 second quarter.
In a statement, the company said it believed it was well-positioned to take advantage of a shift in the security market towards smart cards.
"We continue to attract strategic accounts," chairman and CEI Jean-Gerard Galvez said.
ActivCard was one of the first companies to list on EASDAQ, the European small cap market. There are now 14 companies listed on the exchange.
